notes:
Cut Valet 1.3.4 — faster, and a long list of things that no longer hang

- Opening a project no longer freezes the window; open-project is well under a second on a 3,000-clip project.
- Launch is about a second faster; header pills never wait on Ollama from the window thread.
- Resync creates the Resolve project if you made the project while Resolve was closed, and switches to it if another is open.
- Search & Import places onto a track that exists and no longer refuses every clip at the same frame.
- Update & Restart survives a space in your Windows user name; "Check for Updates" works with automatic checks off; Windows has a Quit line.
- Crash recovery: Resume no longer hangs on a checksum mismatch; read-only camera clips re-copy cleanly; a cancelled drag-and-drop import leaves no "unfinished" session.
- Multi-mic clips get all their audio tracks; a hand-made 01:00:00:00 time-of-day timeline is moved to midnight.
- Settings: every control round-trips; the wizard starts from your current values.
- Transcripts: short speechless clips no longer show a hallucinated "Thank you."
- Diagnostics: crash.log session headers, faulting module on Windows, memory snapshot on Mac, every MCP connection attempt logged.
- A local model whose prompt was cut short is a failed step with the reason, not a poor plan.
added: Time of day sync, for lining up a whole day of cameras.
Tech stack, which scans this computer and tunes itself.
Ingest is a page, so several cards can land at once.
The assistant says what it knows, and every line has a switch.
